title: MY Bharat to organise Yuva Samvad  on Constitution Day; Programme to cover over 600 districts across 30+ States/UTs under the theme ‘Viksit Bharat@2047’
subtitle: Nationwide Student Engagement to Highlight India’s Achievements, Constitutional Values and the Role of Youth in Nation-Building; Participants to collectively read the Preamble to the Constitution
body_text: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports , through Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) , will organise the ‘Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad’ on the occasion of Constitution Day, between 24th and 26th November 2026 , across more than 500 colleges in over 600 districts spanning 30+ States and Union Territories . The nationwide initiative aims to connect young people in the age group of 15–29 years with India's developmental journey, its achievements and aspirations for the future, while inspiring them to become active participants in the nation's transformation into a developed country by 2047. In keeping with the spirit of Constitution Day, participants across institutions will collectively undertake a reading of the Preamble to the Constitution of India , reaffirming their commitment to constitutional values and the ideals enshrined in the Constitution. The programme will also provide a nationwide platform for engaging young people through interactive dialogues and awareness sessions , encouraging them to reflect on India's progress, emerging opportunities and their role in shaping the country's future. To translate this vision into meaningful engagement at the grassroots level, distinguished Youth Icons will lead sessions at participating universities and colleges. As a key component of these engagements, each Youth Icon will deliver a specially curated presentation on the theme ‘Viksit Bharat@2047’ , taking students through India's developmental journey, its achievements in recent years and its aspirations for becoming a developed nation by 2047. The presentation will highlight the country's progress in poverty reduction and socio-economic transformation , including efforts to improve the lives and livelihood opportunities of millions of people through inclusive development and welfare initiatives. It will also showcase India's significant progress in addressing Naxalism , restoring peace and creating an enabling environment for development in previously affected regions. Further, it will emphasise the importance of building a healthy, empowered and addiction-free society, highlighting how substance abuse undermines individual potential, family well-being, societal progress and national productivity. The presentation will underline that a Nasha Mukt Bharat is fundamental to realising the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 , with the youth playing a decisive role in driving this transformation. Adding further depth to these interactions, Padma Awardees will engage with students and share their life journeys, personal experiences and insights, highlighting the challenges they have overcome, the milestones they have achieved and the values that have guided their journeys. These interactions will provide young participants with an opportunity to draw inspiration from their experiences and understand the importance of dedication, perseverance and commitment in contributing to nation-building. The initiative draws inspiration from the vision of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi , articulated in his address on 15th August 2023 from the ramparts of the Red Fort , wherein he called upon the Yuva Shakti to play a pivotal role in realising Viksit Bharat@2047 . Recognising the Amrit Peedhi as a key driver of nation-building, the programme seeks to channelise youth energy and leadership towards achieving this national vision. To translate the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 into action,  the MY Bharat Portal ( mybharat.gov.in ) will serve as the digital platform for registrations and programme-related activities, enabling wider youth participation and facilitating the onboarding of young people into the MY Bharat ecosystem. By combining institutional outreach with digital engagement, the initiative seeks to extend opportunities for participation to youth across the country and encourage them to take up meaningful volunteer-led activities. The programme will also establish a sustained institutional connection with participating colleges and universities. MY Bharat Chapters may subsequently be established in these institutions to facilitate continued youth engagement, promote volunteerism and support the implementation of future MY Bharat initiatives. This will help nurture a network of socially responsible and motivated young citizens who can take forward the spirit of participation, leadership and service beyond the programme. Through the ‘Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad’ , MY Bharat seeks to channelise the energy, ideas and potential of the Amrit Peedhi towards the national vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 . India's journey towards becoming a developed nation is rooted in inclusive growth, social transformation, peace and security, and the empowerment of its citizens. A drug-free India is not merely a social aspiration; it is a national imperative that calls for the active participation of every young citizen. With the message ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat’, the programme aims to transform awareness into action, dialogue into determination and youth participation into a nationwide movement for change. This Constitution Day, MY Bharat invites the youth of India to come together for a collective reading of the Preamble, reaffirm their commitment to the ideals enshrined in the Constitution, and raise their voices for a healthier, stronger and drug-free Bharat. The journey towards Viksit Bharat@2047 will be shaped not only by the aspirations of our youth, but also by the choices they make and the actions they take today. For registrations, programme updates and opportunities to engage with MY Bharat initiatives, visit www.mybharat.gov.in . ***** Gaurav Saini
